answers.question: Can a student with an unresolved financial hold still have their degree conferred and receive their final transcript, even if all academic requirements are complete?
answers.actual_answer: No, a student with an unresolved financial hold cannot have their degree conferred or receive their final transcript, even if all academic requirements are complete. The financial hold blocks official conferral and release of the final transcript until it is resolved.
